headline: Wardens Counter at Nevish Line as Linn of Mercy Ignites
war_summary: Warden counter-pressures have altered the northern balance over the past three hours. Along the Nevish Line, Warden forces pushed back to reclaim ground, resetting the sector to four Colonial positions, three Warden, and one unclaimed ruin following heavy exchanges. Across the Weathered Expanse, relentless shelling continues, though Warden defenders clawed back territory to level the active line at three bases apiece alongside three devastated neutral plots. Linn of Mercy has reignited as the theater's deadliest bloodbath, recording three strategic transitions in the last two hours alone and more than 3,700 combined casualties as battle raged over Lathair and Outwich Ranch. In Mooring County, Warden forces consolidated complete provincial control after repelling incursions at The Wind Hills, while Stonecradle has largely quieted down following its earlier eruption. Although the Dead Lands saw accelerating Warden casualties, base movement remains tightly concentrated within these shifting northern and central sectors.
